translate.guidance:
Do not translate: NimbusDesk, HaloSync.
Portuguese: always translate "workspace" as "espaço de trabalho" (never "área de trabalho"); always translate the button "Save" as "Guardar" (never "Salvar" or "Gravar"); always translate "Billing cycle" as "ciclo de faturação".
Spanish: always translate "workspace" as "espacio de trabajo"; always translate "Save" as "Guardar"; always translate "Billing cycle" as "ciclo de facturación".
Keep ICU placeholders such as {name} unchanged.
